guard: Signed full registration commitment and exact permitted private projection retain issued caller identity without an empty-view bypass. The original authenticated CLI describe predicate must fail with the original registration-versus-view guard restored.
command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/auth build && node --import tsx implementations/auth/smoke/endpoint-authority-public.smoke.ts --cli-describe-causal
why: The original-guard mutant reaches the unchanged genuine source CLI CCLI01 before added native controls, proving that the observed describe-only mismatch is repaired on the real child entry rather than only on hand-built inputs.

Full registration, exact private projection and caller-owner mutations are graded by named adversarial copies of an actual native-resolved service. These prove check dependency but do not simulate a malicious broker entry.
Every mutated core and auth source is rebuilt before the native fixture and rebuilt again after source restoration. No target is graded on a compiler/import failure.

mutations.name: restore original full-registration versus visible-private equality
omit full registration commitment check on empty private view
mutations.replace: false /* mutant ignores full registered commitment */

mutations.name: omit exact signed private closure equality
mutations.find: if (canonicalJson(descriptor.clusters.map(cluster => cluster.digest).sort()) !== canonicalJson([...receipt.privateClusterDigests].sort())) denied("native endpoint private descriptor and verified caller projection disagree");
mutations.replace: // mutant omits the exact signed private closure equality

mutations.name: omit issued principal binding on empty private view
mutations.find: if (service.caller.owner !== receipt.principal.owner || service.caller.actor !== receipt.principal.actor || service.caller.uid !== receipt.principal.uid || !("generation" in service.caller)) denied("native endpoint caller is not the verified issued principal");
mutations.replace: // mutant omits the issued principal binding

mutations.name: omit exact selected application command set
mutations.find: if (canonicalJson([...service.commands.keys()].sort()) !== canonicalJson(allowed) || [...service.commands.values()].some(command => command.class !== "ephemeral" || command.targeted)) denied("native endpoint descriptor widened the verified command selection");
mutations.replace: // mutant omits exact selected application command binding

mutations.name: sign all registered closures as the private projection even for describe-only
mutations.replace: privateClusterDigests.push(closure); // mutant widens signed private projection
